themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can perform complex tasks autonomously within research workflows, analyze data, and even conduct research independently.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers tools and platforms that leverage AI to assist in various aspects of research, from data collection and analysis to insight generation.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools designed to help developers write, debug, and optimize code, often acting as collaborators in the development process.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the creation and use of AI-generated personas or users for simulating user behavior and testing products.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Discusses how AI is integrated into the design and research process to enhance creativity, efficiency, and user understanding.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI capabilities that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries and insights.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Covers AI applications specifically aimed at supporting product managers in areas like roadmap planning, feature prioritization, and market analysis.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is changing job roles, skill requirements, and the overall structure of the workforce.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles detailing research into the effectiveness, user experience, and societal impact of AI-powered chatbots.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to analyze user feedback, comments, and reviews to gauge sentiment and identify key themes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
